_doc: Owner-committed approvals for build-time hard-law exceptions (canonical law: CLAUDE.md working-style item 6; checker: tools/check_build_time.py). Each entry: subject ('airport:<ICAO>' | 'tile:<short_latlon>' | '*'), metric ('total' | 'phase:<label>' | '*'), allowed_seconds (approved ceiling the measured value must stay under), reason (required, non-empty), approved_by (required), date. Hollow entries are ignored by the checker.

approvals.subject: airport:SPJC
approvals.reason: PERF-PHASE P4 ADJUDICATION (owner directive 2026-08-13; RULINGS 'PERFORMANCE PHASE OPENED': budgets adjudicated in-phase; baseline re-record owner-approved at phase open). Ceiling = the 2-run exclusive median measured on the merged wave-1+2 tree (commit d787464), byte-identical x5 to the frozen 1.0.245 manifest. Old committed numbers were 2026-08-04 machine-drift artifacts (13-32% fast). The airport remains over the 60 s budget; the staged-solve round (geometry freeze, one graph, single projection, weld-or-gap retirement) is the chartered path down.

approvals.subject: airport:OTHH
approvals.reason: STAGED-SOLVE ARCHITECTURE FLOOR (owner approval 2026-08-14). The regression is the architecture's own measured cost (Fable whole-pipeline review, lane/solvereg: one-graph+band publish ~+18 net, pair law +14 on fewer executions, rim pockets +10 (the knoll fix, owner-ruled ON), flat-site +13; single projection -15 and emit improvements offset). All optimization suspects exonerated at <=1.5 s; recovery requires OUTPUT-MOVING changes (publish collapse, flag-flavor law gap) which are rulings. What it bought: deterministic builds (ratchet dead), ONE projection, weld-or-gap (walls retired), rim pockets ON, un-blinded census. Owner chartered a dedicated publish/pair-path perf round + the flag-flavor ruling POST-in-sim. Ceilings = closing exclusive 2-run medians.
